No generic waiting/questionmark resurrection; true completion/cancellation/combat/invalid ownership remain authoritative.

Cumulative coalesced outputs, interruption/failure both orders, partial/no-output cancellation, secret/unrelated/duplicate tokens are covered.
Modern observed public spell-ID equality or public recipe-name equality; legacy name mismatch remains fail-closed fallback and needs native validation.
